title: Surfactant-influenced biosorption as a sustainable and effective way for the eradication of environmental pollutants: a review
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00574K, Critical Review

Surfactant assisted biosorption is a powerful sustainable remediation technique for pollution abatement from water medium. The current review highlights the latest developments that took place in this field.
